text_block_list.text:
The day of the Wakagoma Stakes has
arrived.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Just before the race, Токай Тэйо enters
Nice
Nature's waiting room by mistake
and
preemptively declares victory with
great
confidence.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Найс Нэйчер, who has hardly even been

acknowledged by Токай Тэйо, is
determined to
give her a challenge as
she heads to the
racecourse.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
